name: A Troll's Grim Mercy: a Cage credits Hostages freed once per life and respawns (COA-10437)
contract: Quest 175053 needs 10 Hostages freed via creature 164064, credited from the Cage GO 2300662's not-repeatable On Use smart_scripts event (action 33). The Cage is a non-consumable GOOBER, so without a despawn its AI never reset and each of the 22 Cages credited once per grid load for the whole server. The event now runs only for players on the quest, so a click by q without it leaves the Cage closed and unconsumed. p's use credits once, repeated clicks do not, the Cage despawns 8 s later with its hostage and respawns after its 120 s spawn timer. The respawned Cage credits again and opens natively, which needs GO_FLAG_IN_USE cleared after the despawn inside its 45 s open window.
